units.zh: 武帝每延群臣，多說平生常事，未嘗及經國遠圖。
units.literal: Whenever Emperor Wu extended audiences to ministers he spoke mostly of trivial personal matters and never touched long-term state plans.
units.idiomatic: At court he dwelt on small talk, never on how to steer the empire.

units.zh: 二月，曹爽白嗣主，轉宣帝為太傅，外示尊崇，內實欲令事先由已。
units.literal: In the second month Cao Shuang informed the young lord, transferring Emperor Xuan to grand tutor, outwardly honoring him while in truth wishing every decision to pass through himself.
units.idiomatic: Cao Shuang "promoted" Sima Yi to figurehead tutor while hoarding real power.

units.zh: 太康三年四月旱，乙酉詔司空齊王攸與尚書、廷尉、河南尹錄訊系囚，事從蠲宥。
units.literal: Third year, fourth month drought; on yiyou an edict ordered Sikong Prince Qi You with the Shangshu, tingwei, and Henan Yin to review prisoners and grant mercy as fit.
units.idiomatic: Taikang 3's dry fourth month forced an amnesty review led by Sima You.

units.zh: 是時荀勖、馮紞僭作威福，亂朝尤甚。
units.literal: At that time Xun Xu and Feng Dan presumptuously wielded favor and terror, disordering the court worst of all.
units.idiomatic: Xun Xu and Feng Dan terrorized the bureaucracy unchecked.

units.zh: 是年春，三王討趙王倫，六旬之中數十戰，死者十餘萬人。
units.literal: That spring the three kings campaigned against Prince Zhao Lun; within sixty days dozens of battles, more than a hundred thousand dead.
units.idiomatic: The war on Sima Lun killed over a hundred thousand in two months.

units.zh: 是年三月，司馬越歸京都，遣兵入宮，收中書令繆播等九人殺之，皆僭逾之罰也。
units.literal: That year's third month Sima Yue returned to the capital, sent troops into the palace, seized Zhongshu Ling Miu Bo and nine others and killed them — all punishments for presumption.
units.idiomatic: Sima Yue's palace coup and execution of Miu Bo's circle exemplified overreach.

units.zh: 是時成帝沖弱，未親萬機，內外之政，決之將相。
units.literal: At that time Emperor Cheng was young and weak, had not yet taken the myriad threads; inner and outer policy was decided by generals and ministers.
units.idiomatic: The boy emperor left statecraft to generals and ministers.

units.zh: 是時桓溫強恣，權制朝廷，僭逾之罰也。
units.literal: At that time Huan Wen acted with force and license, controlling the court at will — punishment for presumption.
units.idiomatic: Huan Wen's stranglehold on the court explained the omen.

units.zh: 去歲北府遣戍胡陸，荊州經略河南。
units.literal: Last year the Northern Headquarters sent garrisons to Hulu; Jing province planned operations south of the Yellow River.
units.idiomatic: Frontier garrisons on the Huai line matched the timing.

units.zh: 是時烈宗仁恕，信任會稽王道子，政事舒緩。
units.literal: At that time Emperor Liezong was lenient and trusting; he relied on Prince Kuaiji, Sima Daozi; government affairs were slack.
units.idiomatic: Xiaowu's softness and Dao-zi's lax rule framed the gloss.

units.zh: 又茹千秋為驃騎諮議，竊弄主相威福。
units.literal: Moreover Ru Qianqiu was counselor to the cavalry general, privately twisting sovereign and ministerial authority.
units.idiomatic: Ru Qianqiu sold offices between prince and throne.

units.zh: 又所在多上春竟囚，不以其辜，建康獄吏，枉暴既甚。
units.literal: Moreover everywhere men pressed spring trials to closure without guilt proven; Jiankang jailers were wildly cruel.
units.idiomatic: Judicial torture in the capital ran unchecked.

units.zh: 時桓玄奢僭，十二月遂篡位。
units.literal: At that time Huan Xuan was extravagant and presumptuous; in the twelfth month he usurped the throne.
units.idiomatic: Huan Xuan's luxury coup closed the drought narrative.

units.zh: 會帝疾篤，急召之，乃乘追鋒車東渡河，終如童謠之言。
units.literal: The emperor grew desperately ill and summoned him; he rode the "pursuit-blade" carriage east across the river — exactly as the rhyme said.
units.idiomatic: A dying summons sent him racing east instead, matching the omen.

units.zh: 鼉有鱗介，甲兵之象。
units.literal: Alligators have scales and shell — an image of armor and weapons.
units.idiomatic: Scaly creatures signified war gear.

units.zh: 太康末，京洛為《折楊柳》之歌，其曲始有兵革苦辛之辭，終以擒獲斬截之事。
units.literal: Late Taikang, capital Luoyang sang "Breaking Willows"; the tune began with the bitterness of war and ended with capture and beheading.
units.idiomatic: A new pop song moved from battlefield sorrow to executions.

units.zh: 及楊駿居內府，以戟為衛，死時又為戟所害傷。
units.literal: When Yang Jun dwelt in the inner palace he used halberds for guards; at death he was again wounded by halberds.
units.idiomatic: Yang Jun's halberd corps foretold his own skewering.

units.zh: 言賈后將與謐為亂，以危太子，而趙王因釁咀嚼豪賢，以成篡奪，不得其死之應也。
units.literal: It means Empress Jia would riot with Mi to endanger the heir, while Prince Zhao would chew up great men and seize the throne — an omen of dying badly.
units.idiomatic: The gloss tied the verses to Jia's coup plot and Sima Lun's coming slaughter.

units.zh: 後中原大亂，宗籓多絕，唯琅邪、汝南、西陽、南頓、彭城同至江東，而元帝嗣統矣。
units.literal: Later the central plain collapsed; most imperial kin perished; only Langya, Runan, Xiyang, Nandun, and Pengcheng reached the east of the river, and Yuan-di succeeded.
units.idiomatic: Only five princely lines escaped to Jiangdong where Sima Rui took the mandate.

units.zh: 其後三年，錢鳳復攻京邑，阻水而守，相持月餘日，焚燒城邑，井堙木刊矣。
units.literal: Three years later Qian Feng again attacked the capital, blocked the river and held, faced off over a month, burned towns, filled wells and felled trees.
units.idiomatic: Qian Feng's second siege charred Jiankang and ruined its wells and groves.

units.zh: 鳳等敗退，沈充將其党還吳興，官軍踵之，蹈藉郡縣，充父子授首，黨與誅者以百數。
units.literal: When Feng retreated, Shen Chong led his party back to Wuxing; imperial troops followed, trampling commanderies; Chong and son lost their heads; over a hundred accomplices were executed.
units.idiomatic: Shen Chong's retreat ended in beheadings and mass executions.

units.zh: 峻死後，石據石頭，尋為諸公所破，復是崩山石破之應也。
units.literal: After Jun died Shi held Stone City but was soon broken by the lords — again the omen of collapsing mountain and splitting stone.
units.idiomatic: Su Shi's brief hold on Shitou completed the prophecy.

units.zh: 後連征不入，及薨於鎮，以喪還都葬，皆如謠言。
units.literal: Later repeated summons failed; he died in post and his bier returned to the capital for burial — all as the rhymes said.
units.idiomatic: Yu Liang died at his post and came home for burial on cue.

units.zh: 會稽王道子於東府造土山，名曰靈秀山。
units.literal: Prince Kuaiji Sima Daozi built an earthen hill at the Eastern Bureau named Mount Lingxiu.
units.idiomatic: Daozi piled Lingxiu Hill beside his yamen.

units.zh: 玄之宮女及逆党之家子女妓妾悉為軍賞，東及甌越，北流淮泗，皆人有所獲。
units.literal: Xuan's palace women and rebel households' daughters and concubines all became army spoils — east to Ou-Yue, north along Huai-Si — everyone took a share.
units.idiomatic: Victors parceled out Xuan's harem across the southeast.

units.zh: 及玄敗，走至江陵，時正五月中，誅如其期焉。
units.literal: When Xuan fell he fled to Jiangling; it was exactly the fifth month — the execution matched the season.
units.idiomatic: His fifth-month death answered the crow omen.

units.zh: 其時官養盧龍，寵以金紫，奉以名州，養之極也。
units.literal: At the time the court coddled Lu Long with gold-purple ribbons and a great province — the utmost indulgence.
units.idiomatic: Lu Long won rank and region for doing nothing.

units.zh: 而龍不能懷我好音，舉兵內伐，遂成仇敵也。
units.literal: Yet Long could not cherish our good faith; he raised arms inward and became an enemy.
units.idiomatic: He repaid favor with rebellion.

units.zh: 及堅在位凡三十年，敗于淝水，是其應也。
units.literal: When Jian had reigned thirty years he lost at the Fei River — the fulfillment.
units.idiomatic: His Fei River rout matched the prophecy.

units.zh: 及淮南敗還，初為慕容沖所攻，又為姚萇所殺，身死國滅。
units.literal: After the Huainan defeat Murong Chong first struck him, then Yao Chang killed him — body dead, state gone.
units.idiomatic: Murong Chong and Yao Chang finished him after Feishui.

units.zh: 至元康九年，始殺太子，距此十四年。
units.literal: By Yuankang 9 they first killed the crown prince — fourteen years from this omen.
units.idiomatic: Fourteen years later the heir died.

units.zh: 太康七年十一月丙辰，四角獸見於河間，河間王顒獲以獻。
units.literal: In the seventh year of Taikang, eleventh month bingchen a horned beast with four corners appeared in Hejian; Prince Hejian Yong caught and presented it.
units.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Taikang, Sima Yong sent up a quadruple-horned monster.

units.zh: 天戒若曰，角，兵象也，四者，四方之象，當有兵亂起于四方。
units.literal: Heaven's warning: horns mean arms; four means the four directions — war will rise from every quarter.
units.idiomatic: Four horns forecast multilateral rebellion.

units.zh: 後河間王遂連四方之兵，作為亂階，殆其應也。
units.literal: Later Prince Hejian linked hosts from four directions and made rebellion — likely its answer.
units.idiomatic: Yong's coalition fulfilled the beast sign.

units.zh: 自喪亂以後，風教陵夷，秀孝策試，乏四科之實。
units.literal: Since the turmoil manners decayed; examination essays lacked the four categories' substance.
units.idiomatic: Postwar exams had hollow essays.

units.zh: 天戒若曰，兔，野物也，而集宗廟之堂，不祥莫之甚焉。
units.literal: Heaven's warning: rabbits are wild things; for one to gather on the temple hall — no ill greater.
units.idiomatic: Wild hares on the altar spelled extreme sacrilege.

units.zh: 公孫文懿家有犬，冠幘絳衣上屋，此犬禍也。
units.literal: Gongsun Wenyi's household had a dog that capped itself in crimson robes and climbed the roof — a dog disaster.
units.idiomatic: A robed dog on the ridge mocked Wenyi's kingship bid.

units.zh: 天戒若曰，亢陽無上，偷自尊高，狗而冠者也。
units.literal: Heaven warns: arrogant yang without limit, stealing supreme honor — a dog wearing a cap.
units.idiomatic: Heaven called the dog a crowned usurper.

units.zh: 魏侍中應璩在直廬，欻見一白狗出門，問眾人，無見者。
units.literal: Wei attendant Ying Qu in the duty lodge suddenly saw a white dog leave the gate; he asked others — none saw it.
units.idiomatic: Ying Qu alone glimpsed a phantom white hound.

units.zh: 吳諸葛恪征淮南歸，將朝會，犬銜引其衣。
units.literal: Wu's Zhuge Ke returning from Huainan campaign, about to court audience, a dog seized his robe.
units.idiomatic: A dog tugged Zhuge Ke's gown before court.

units.zh: 有頃復起，犬又銜衣，乃令逐犬，遂升車，入而被害。
units.literal: Soon he rose again; the dog seized his robe again; he ordered the dog driven off, mounted his carriage, entered and was killed.
units.idiomatic: Ignoring the second tug cost him his life at court.

units.zh: 還置窟中，覆以磨石，經宿失所在。
units.literal: They returned them to the pit, covered it with millstones; by morning they were gone.
units.idiomatic: The pups vanished beneath the stone cover.

units.zh: 案《漢書》，景帝時有此，以為悖亂之氣，亦犬豕禍也。
units.literal: The Book of Han records the same under Emperor Jing of Han, calling it perverse qi — also dog-and-pig disaster.
units.idiomatic: Historians cited Han parallels for the abomination.

units.zh: 逆言失聽，異類相交，必生害也。
units.literal: When words rebel and hearing fails, different kinds coupling must breed harm.
units.idiomatic: Unnatural unions mirrored a deaf court.

units.zh: 元帝太興中，吳郡太守張懋聞齋內床下犬聲，求而不得。
units.literal: Mid-Taixing Emperor Yuan — Wu commandery prefect Zhang Mao heard dog sounds under his bedchamber bed but found nothing.
units.idiomatic: Zhang Mao's yamen hound that was not there.

units.zh: 既而地自坼，見有二犬子，取而養之，皆死。
units.literal: Then the earth split; two puppies appeared; he took and raised them — both died.
units.idiomatic: Earth-rend pups died under his care.

units.zh: 太興四年，廬江灊縣何旭家忽聞地中有犬子聲，掘之得一母犬，青釐色，狀甚羸瘦，走入草中，不知所在。
units.literal: Taixing 4: He Xu's household in Qian county, Lujiang, heard puppy barks underground; digging, they found a bitch blue-gray, emaciated; she fled into grass and vanished.
units.idiomatic: A subterranean bitch escaped He Xu's diggers.

units.zh: 視其處有二犬子，一雄一雌，哺而養之，雌死雄活。
units.literal: At the spot were two pups, male and female; they nursed them — the female died, the male lived.
units.idiomatic: One pup survived to adulthood.

units.zh: 是時輔國將軍孫無終家于既陽，地中聞犬子聲，尋而地坼，有二犬子，皆白色，一雄一雌，取而養之，皆死。
units.literal: Then Fuguo general Sun Wuzhong at Jiyang heard puppy sounds underground; earth split; two white pups, male and female — raised, both died.
units.idiomatic: Sun Wuzhong duplicated the underground pup omen.

units.zh: 桓玄將拜楚王，已設拜席，群官陪位。
units.literal: Huan Xuan was about to be invested Prince of Chu; the investiture mat was set; officials stood attendance.
units.idiomatic: Xuan prepared his king-making ceremony.

units.zh: 明年宮車晏駕，王室始騷，卒以亂亡。
units.literal: Next year the imperial carriage halted; the royal house first stirred and ended in chaos.
units.idiomatic: Sima Yan died; turmoil followed.

units.zh: 車騎大將軍、東嬴王騰自并州遷鎮鄴，行次真定。
units.literal: Cavalry general East Ying Prince Teng moved headquarters from Bingzhou to Ye, halting at Zhending.
units.idiomatic: Sima Teng marched toward Ye.

units.zh: 時久積雪，而當門前方數丈獨消釋，騰怪而掘之，得玉馬，高尺許，口齒缺。
units.literal: Snow lay long yet several zhang before his gate alone melted; Teng wondered, dug, found a jade horse a chi tall with broken teeth.
units.idiomatic: Melted snow revealed a toothless jade horse.

units.zh: 然馬無齒則不得食，妖祥之兆，衰亡之征。
units.literal: Yet a horse without teeth cannot eat — an omen both freakish and blessed, sign of decline.
units.idiomatic: Toothless mount spelled hungry power.

units.zh: 是後騰為汲桑所殺，而天下遂亂。
units.literal: Afterward Teng was killed by Ji Sang and the realm slid into chaos.
units.idiomatic: Ji Sang slew him; anarchy spread.

units.zh: 軍中有小兒，出於襄城繁昌縣，年八歲，發體悉白，頗能卜，于《洪范》，白祥也。
units.literal: Among the troops a boy from Xiangcheng Fanchang, age eight, all white-haired, could divine — per Hong Fan, white omen.
units.idiomatic: An albino child divined in Jiong's host.

units.zh: 於是方鎮屢革，邊戍仍遷，皆擁帶部曲，動有萬數。
units.literal: Then frontier commands rotated endlessly; garrisons shifted; each led private hosts numbering myriads.
units.idiomatic: Warlord militias multiplied on the borders.

units.zh: 其間征伐征賦，役無寧歲，天下勞擾，百姓疲怨。
units.literal: Amid campaigns and levies no year knew rest; the world toiled; people wearied and resented.
units.idiomatic: Endless corvée enraged the north.

units.zh: 是時苻堅滅後，經略多事，人勞之應也。
units.literal: At the time after Fu Jian's fall planning multiplied — an omen of human exhaustion.
units.idiomatic: Post-Feishui scheming matched the sign.

units.zh: 郊禖壇者，求子之神位，無故自毀，太子將危之象也。
units.literal: The suburban Subs altar is the god-seat for seeking sons; it broke without cause — image of the heir in peril.
units.idiomatic: Broken altar spelled doom for the crown prince.

units.zh: 天戒若曰，安徒揚經略之聲，終無其實，鉦鼓不用之象也。
units.literal: Heaven warns: An boasted of campaigns yet achieved none — bells and drums unused.
units.idiomatic: Silent drums mocked empty strategy.

units.zh: 盛夏日長，暑以養物，政弛緩，故其罰常燠也。
units.literal: Midsummer days lengthen; heat nurtures things; government relaxes — hence the punishment is constant heat.
units.idiomatic: Lax rule draws the scourge of endless summer.

units.zh: 燠則冬溫，春夏不和，傷病疾人，其極疾也。
units.literal: When it is torrid, winter is warm, spring and summer discordant, injuring the sick — its extreme is sickness.
units.idiomatic: Mild winters and sickly seasons mark the nadir.

units.zh: 誅不行則霜不殺草，繇臣下則殺不以時，故有草妖。
units.literal: When executions fail frost does not kill grass; when fault lies with ministers killing is untimely — hence grass portents.
units.idiomatic: Untimely justice lets weeds thrive — "grass omens."

units.zh: 凡妖，貌則以服，言則以詩，聽則以聲。
units.literal: Generally among portents appearance shows in dress, speech in songs, hearing in sound.
units.idiomatic: Omens dress as costume, verse, or noise.

units.zh: 視不以色者，五色，物之大分也，在於眚祥，故聖人以為草妖，失物柄之明者也。
units.literal: Sight not by color — the five colors are the great allotment of things; ill-omens dwell there; hence sages treat freak grass as loss of clear sight.
units.idiomatic: Because color vision fails, sages read plant freaks as blurred rule.

units.zh: 溫燠生蟲，故有蠃蟲之孽，謂螟螣之類當死不死，當生而不生，或多於故而為災也。
units.literal: Warmth breeds insects — hence soft-shelled insect calamity: caterpillars that should die yet live, should live yet fail, or swarm beyond norm.
units.idiomatic: Heat-born vermin mean soft-shell plagues.

units.zh: 羊上角下蹄，剛而苞柔，羊大目而不精明，視氣毀，故有羊禍。
units.literal: Sheep horn above hoof below — hard wrapping soft; sheep have big yet dull eyes — sight qi ruined — hence sheep disaster.
units.idiomatic: Sheep embody dim vision — "sheep calamity."

units.zh: 劉歆《視傳》曰有羽蟲之孽，雞禍。
units.literal: Liu Xin's Treatise on Sight adds feathered insect calamity and chicken disaster.
units.idiomatic: Liu Xin adds fowl portents.

units.zh: 說以為于天文南方硃張為鳥星，故為羽蟲。
units.literal: Exegesis holds that in astronomy the southern Zhu-Zhang is the bird star — hence feathered insects.
units.idiomatic: The Vermilion Bird mansion governs winged pests.

units.zh: 小燠不書，無冰然後書，舉其大者也。
units.literal: Small heat is not written; only when there is no ice is it recorded — lifting the great case.
units.idiomatic: Annalists note only total failure of winter freeze.

units.zh: 是時諸葛恪始輔政，息校官，原逋責，除關梁，崇寬厚，此舒緩之應也。
units.literal: Then Zhuge Ke began assisting, halted secret police, forgave arrears, opened barriers, favored leniency — an answer of slackness.
units.idiomatic: Ke's reforms briefly softened the regime — matching the omen.

units.zh: 時少帝深樹恩德，事崇優緩，此其應也。
units.literal: Then the young emperor piled kindness and preferred lax rule — its answer.
units.idiomatic: His indulgent style explained the sign.

units.zh: 時帝初即位，楚王瑋矯詔誅汝南王亮及太保衛瓘，帝不能察。
units.literal: The emperor had just mounted the throne; Prince Chu Wei forged edicts killing Prince Runan Liang and grand tutor Wei Guan — the emperor could not investigate.
units.idiomatic: Sima Wei's coup caught the new throne blind.

units.zh: 昔三苗將亡，五穀變種，此草妖也。
units.literal: When the Three Miao were about to perish the five grains changed species — this is grass portent.
units.idiomatic: Ancient precedent: mutating crops meant doom.

units.zh: 言曹者眾也，魏者大也，眾而大，天下其當會也。
units.literal: It means Cao is "many," Wei is "great"; many and great — the realm will unite.
units.idiomatic: The riddle spelled Cao-Wei swallowing Shu.

units.zh: 長老相傳：此湖塞，天下亂；
units.literal: Elders handed down: when this lake blocks, the realm is chaotic;
units.idiomatic: Folk wisdom tied the lake to order.

units.zh: 天紀三年八月，建鄴有鬼目菜于工黃狗家生，依緣棗樹，長丈餘，莖廣四寸，厚二分。
units.literal: In the third year of Tianji, eighth month at Jianye "ghost-eye" greens grew at artisan Huang Gou's home, twining a jujube, over a zhang long, stem four cun wide, two fen thick.
units.idiomatic: In the third year of Tianji, Weird vines sprouted on a craftsman's jujube.

units.zh: 又有蕒菜生工吳平家，高四尺，如枇杷形，上圓，徑一尺八寸，莖廣五寸，兩邊生葉，綠色。
units.literal: Also "mai" greens grew at artisan Wu Ping's home, four chi high, loquat-shaped, round top, diameter one chi eight cun, stem five cun wide, leaves green on both sides.
units.idiomatic: A second freak crop rose at Wu Ping's door.

units.zh: 東觀案圖，名鬼目作芝萆，蕒菜作平慮，遂以狗為侍芝郎，平為平慮郎，皆銀印青綬。
units.literal: Eastern Archives checked charts: ghost-eye was titled zhi-cao, mai was titled "peace-calmer"; they made Gou herb attendant and Ping peace attendant — silver seal, blue ribbon.
units.idiomatic: The court jokingly ennobled the plants and artisans.

units.zh: 干寶曰：明年平吳，王浚止船正得平渚，姓名顯然，指事之征也。
units.literal: Gan Bao said: next year Wu was pacified; Wang Jun moored exactly at Ping islet — names plainly pointed to the event.
units.idiomatic: Gan Bao read the names as prophecy of conquest.

units.zh: 黃狗者，吳以土運承漢，故初有黃龍之瑞。
units.literal: Yellow dog — Wu, earth phase succeeding Han, first had yellow dragon omens.
units.idiomatic: Yellow stood for Wu's earth succession.

units.zh: 黃稱不改，而貴賤大殊，天道精微之應敢也。
units.literal: The color name stayed yet noble and base inverted vastly — Heaven's subtle answer.
units.idiomatic: Same hue, opposite fortune — Heaven's irony.

units.zh: 此與殷太戊同妖，太子不能悟，故至廢戮也。
units.literal: This matches Yin emperor Taiwu's portent; the heir could not understand — hence deposition and slaughter.
units.idiomatic: Like Shang precedent, the crown prince ignored the sign.

units.zh: 五月甲子，就東宮，桑又生於西廂。
units.literal: Fifth month jiazi — entering the Eastern Palace mulberry again grew in the west wing.
units.idiomatic: The mulberry returned when Zang entered.

units.zh: 明年，趙王倫篡位，鴆殺臧，此與湣懷同妖也。
units.literal: Next year Prince Zhao Lun usurped and poisoned Zang — same portent as Min and Huai.
units.idiomatic: Lun's coup killed Zang like earlier heirs.

units.zh: 是時京師虛弱，胡寇交侵，東海王越無衛國之心，四年冬季而南出，五年春薨於此城。
units.literal: Then the capital was weak, Hu raiders crossed, Prince Donghai Yue had no mind to defend; winter of year four he marched south; spring five he died in that city.
units.idiomatic: Sima Yue abandoned Luoyang and died on campaign.

units.zh: 石勒邀其眾，圍而射之，王公以下至眾庶，死者十餘萬人。
units.literal: Shi Le ambushed his host, surrounded and shot them; from princes down to commoners over a hundred thousand died.
units.idiomatic: Shi Le massacred Yue's army.

units.zh: 是敗也，中原無所請命，洛京亦尋覆沒，桑哭之應也。
units.literal: That defeat left the central plain without refuge; Luoyang soon fell — answer to mulberry weeping.
units.idiomatic: The fall of Jin answered the crying trees.

units.zh: 六年五月，無錫縣有四株茱萸樹，相樛而生，狀若連理。
units.literal: Sixth year fifth month — four cornus trees in Wuxi county intertwined like intertwined virtue.
units.idiomatic: Dogwood trees fused in Wuxi.

units.zh: 及此木生，其後徐馥果作亂，亦草妖也。
units.literal: When this tree appeared Xu Fu indeed rebelled — also grass portent.
units.idiomatic: Xu Fu's rising matched the dogwood.

units.zh: 其七月，豫章郡有樟樹久枯，是月忽更榮茂，與漢昌邑枯社復生同占。
units.literal: That seventh month a long-dead camphor in Yuzhang commandery suddenly flourished — same reading as Han Changyi's withered altar reviving.
units.idiomatic: A dead camphor greened like Han portents.

units.zh: 昔漢哀成之世並有此妖，而人貌備具，故春禍亦大。
units.literal: Han emperors Ai and Cheng had this too, yet faces were complete — hence great calamity.
units.idiomatic: Han precedents were graver.

units.zh: 時孝武年始四歲，俄而哀帝崩，海西即位，未幾而廢，簡文越自籓王，入纂大業，登阼享國，又不逾二年，而孝武嗣統。
units.literal: Then Xiaowu was only four; soon Ai died, Haixi took throne, soon deposed; Jianwen crossed from prince to inherit, ruled under two years, then Xiaowu succeeded.
units.idiomatic: The tree marked the whirl of four emperors.

units.zh: 帝諱昌明，識者竊謂西昌修明之祥，帝諱實應焉。
units.literal: The emperor's taboo name was Changming; augurs secretly said Xichang-Xiuming omens matched his name.
units.idiomatic: Place names echoed Sima Yao's taboo.

units.zh: 天戒若曰，松者不改柯易葉，楊者柔脆之木，今松生於楊，豈非永久之業將集危亡之地邪？
units.literal: Heaven warns: pine never changes bough or leaf; poplar is soft and brittle; pine growing on poplar — does not lasting enterprise gather where peril waits?
units.idiomatic: Hard pine on soft poplar mocked false permanence.

units.zh: 十餘年中，姚泓滅，兵始戢，是苦蕒之應也。
units.literal: Within a dozen years Yao Hong was destroyed and arms finally rested — answer of the bitter greens.
units.idiomatic: Yao Hong's fall ended the campaigns.

units.zh: 義熙中，宮城上及御道左右皆生蒺藜，亦草妖也。
units.literal: Yixi years — thorns grew on palace walls and along the imperial ways — also grass portent.
units.idiomatic: Jiankang's walls sprouted caltrops.

units.zh: 生宮牆及馳道，天戒若曰，人君不聽政，雖有宮室馳道，若空廢也，故生蒺藜。
units.literal: Growing on palace wall and carriage road, Heaven warns: the ruler neglects government — though halls and highways exist they are void — hence thorns.
units.idiomatic: Heaven turned avenues into brambles for an idle throne.

units.zh: 於是楊彪、管寧之徒咸見薦舉，些所謂睹妖知懼者也。
units.literal: Thereupon Yang Biao, Guan Ning, and such were recommended — this is seeing portent and fearing.
units.idiomatic: Notables were nominated in response.

units.zh: 然猶不能優容亮直而多溺偏私矣。
units.literal: Yet he still could not indulge straight speech and drowned in partiality.
units.idiomatic: Favoritism persisted despite the scare.

units.zh: 景初元年，又有燕生巨鷇於衛國李蓋家，形若鷹，吻似燕，此羽蟲之孽，又赤眚也。
units.literal: Jingchu 1 — another swallow laid a giant chick at Li Gai's home in Wey; shaped like an eagle, beak like a swallow — feathered calamity, also red ill-omen.
units.idiomatic: A second freak hatchling augured Cao Wei's end.

units.zh: 是時諸葛亮連年動眾，志吞中夏，而終死渭南，所圖不遂。
units.literal: Then Zhuge Liang campaigned yearly, aimed to swallow the central plain, yet died south of Wei River — plans unfulfilled.
units.idiomatic: Zhuge's northern drives stalled at Wei River.

units.zh: 又諸將分爭，頗喪徒旅，鳥北飛不能達墮水死者，皆有其象也。
units.literal: Also generals quarreled, losing troops; birds failing north and drowning matched each item.
units.idiomatic: The drownings mirrored Shu's failed offensives.

units.zh: 此與漢時楚國烏鬥墮泗水粗類矣。
units.literal: This roughly matches Han-era Chu crows fighting and falling into Si River.
units.idiomatic: Historians recalled Han crow omens.

units.zh: 景初元年，陵霄闕始構，有鵲巢其上。
units.literal: Jingchu 1 — Lingxiao Gate began construction; magpies nested atop.
units.idiomatic: Magpies built on the new tower.

units.zh: 鵲體白黑雜色，此羽蟲之孽，又白黑祥也。
units.literal: Magpie body mottled white-black — feathered calamity, also white-black omen.
units.idiomatic: Pied magpies doubled as yin-yang portent.

units.zh: 是時權意溢德衰，信讒好殺，二子將危，將相俱殆，睹妖不悟，加之以燎，昧道之甚者也。
units.literal: Then Quan's intent overflowed while virtue waned; he trusted slander and loved killing; two heirs were endangered, generals imperiled; seeing portent yet unawares he added fire sacrifice — utmost blindness.
units.idiomatic: Sun Quan burned the omen and deepened his moral blindness.

units.zh: 明年，太子和廢，魯王霸賜死，硃據左遷，陸議憂卒，是其應也。
units.literal: Next year Heir Apparent He was deposed, Prince Ba forced to die, Zhu Ju demoted, Lu Xun died of grief — the answer.
units.idiomatic: The succession war consumed his heirs and ministers.

units.zh: 和故宮僚聞之，皆憂慘，以為檣末傾危，非久安之象。
units.literal: Sun He's former staff heard it and grieved, reckoning mast-ends tottering — no sign of long peace.
units.idiomatic: His retinue saw disaster in the rigging.

units.zh: 天戒若曰，閶闔門非雉所止，猶殷宗雉登鼎耳之戒也。
units.literal: Heaven warns: Changhe Gate is no place for pheasants — like Shang's pheasant on the cauldron ear.
units.idiomatic: The gate omen recalled Shang dynasty precedent.

units.zh: 持者即還白倫，倫使更求，又見之，乃將入宮，密籠鳥，並閉小兒戶中，明日視之，悉不見。
units.literal: The bearer reported to Lun; Lun sent to find him again, caged the bird with the boy locked in; next day both vanished.
units.idiomatic: Lun imprisoned bird and prophet — both disappeared.

units.zh: 時趙王倫有目瘤之疾，言服留者，謂倫留將服其罪也。
units.literal: Then Prince Zhao Lun had an eye tumor; "stay-cloak" meant Lun would soon suffer punishment.
units.idiomatic: The pun foretold Lun's execution.

units.zh: 趙王倫篡位，有鶉入太極殿，雉集東堂。
units.literal: When Prince Zhao Lun usurped, quail entered Taiji Hall, pheasants gathered east hall.
units.idiomatic: Game birds invaded the throne hall.

units.zh: 天戒若曰，太極東堂皆朝享聽政之所，而鶉雉同日集之者，趙王倫不當居此位也。
units.literal: Heaven warns: Taiji and east hall are where court meets — quail and pheasant the same day means Lun must not occupy that seat.
units.idiomatic: Twin fowl barred his legitimacy.

units.zh: 是後，劉元海、石勒相繼亂華。
units.literal: Thereafter Liu Yuan and Shi Le successively ravaged the Chinese heartland.
units.idiomatic: The barbarian onslaught followed.

units.zh: 明帝八月庚戌，有大鳥二，蒼黑色，翼廣一丈四尺，其一集司徒府，射而殺之，其一集市北家人舍，亦獲焉。
units.literal: Emperor Ming eighth month gengxu — two great bluish-black birds, wings one zhang four chi wide; one perched at Minister of Education residence, shot dead; one at north-city home, also taken.
units.idiomatic: Twin black birds presaged Ming-di's death.

units.zh: 及閏月戊子而帝崩，後遂有蘇峻、祖約之亂。
units.literal: By intercalary month wuzi the emperor died; afterward Su Jun and Zu Yue rebelled.
units.idiomatic: Su Jun's mutiny followed the birds.

units.zh: 是時庾亮苟違眾謀，將召蘇峻，有言不從之咎，故白祥先見也。
units.literal: Then Yu Liang rashly defied counsel and would summon Su Jun — fault of words unheeded — hence white omen first.
units.idiomatic: Yu Liang's stubbornness prefaced white gulls.

units.zh: 三年二月，峻果作亂，宮掖焚毀，化為汙萊，此其應也。
units.literal: Third year second month Jun indeed rebelled; palace burned to wasteland — the answer.
units.idiomatic: Su Jun torched the inner palace.

units.zh: 十八年東宮始成，十九年正月鵲又巢其西門。
units.literal: Eighteenth year Eastern Palace finished; nineteenth year first month magpies nested its west gate.
units.idiomatic: Crown prince halls drew magpies too.

units.zh: 婢炊飯，忽有群烏集灶，競來啄噉，婢驅遂不去。
units.literal: A maidservant cooked; suddenly crows massed on the stove competing to peck food; she drove them but they would not go.
units.idiomatic: Crows swarmed the camp kitchen fire.

units.zh: 有獵狗咋殺兩烏，余烏因共啄殺狗，又噉其肉，唯餘骨存。
units.literal: A hunting dog bit two crows; the rest together pecked the dog dead and ate its flesh until only bones remained.
units.idiomatic: Crows mobbed and devoured the hound.

units.zh: 明年，蘇峻破京都，導與帝俱幽石頭，僅乃得免，是其應也。
units.literal: Next year Su Jun took the capital; Dao and the emperor were both imprisoned at Stone City, barely escaping — the answer.
units.idiomatic: Su Jun's coup trapped Wang Dao with the boy emperor.

units.zh: 公孫文懿時，襄平北市生肉，長圍各數尺，有頭目口喙，無手足而動搖，此赤祥也。
units.literal: Under Gongsun Wenyi — north market of Xiangping grew flesh several chi long and wide, with head, eyes, and beak, no limbs yet writhing — red omen.
units.idiomatic: Self-moving meat appeared in Liaodong market.

units.zh: 吳戍將鄧喜殺豬祠神，治畢懸之，忽見一人頭往食肉，喜引弓射中之，咋咋作聲，繞屋三日，近赤祥也。
units.literal: Wu garrison commander Deng Xi slaughtered a pig for a shrine; hung it; suddenly a human head came to eat the meat; Xi shot it; it crackled, circling the roof three days — near red omen.
units.idiomatic: A flying head feasted on Deng Xi's offering.

units.zh: 後人白喜謀北叛，闔門被誅。
units.literal: Later men accused Xi of plotting northern rebellion; his whole clan was executed.
units.idiomatic: Xi's family died for treason.

units.zh: 是後四載而帝崩，王室遂亂。
units.literal: Four years later the emperor died; the royal house then fell into chaos.
units.idiomatic: Sima Yan perished; turmoil followed.

units.zh: 夫政刑舒緩，則有常燠赤祥之妖。
units.literal: When government and punishments are slack there are omens of constant heat and red freaks.
units.idiomatic: Lax justice invites thermal and sanguinary signs.

units.zh: 於是王室成釁，禍流天下。
units.literal: Thereupon the royal house bore scandal; disaster spread under heaven.
units.idiomatic: Dynastic shame ignited civil war.

units.zh: 四年十二月丙寅，丞相府斬督運令史淳于伯，血逆流上柱二丈三尺，此赤祥也。
units.literal: Fourth year twelfth month bingyin — chief minister's office executed transport clerk Chunyu Bo; blood flowed upward two zhang three chi along a pillar — red omen.
units.idiomatic: Chunyu Bo's blood defied gravity in the ministry yard.

units.zh: 及有變，司直彈劾眾官，元帝不問，遂頻旱三年。
units.literal: When the anomaly came rectifiers impeached many officials; Yuan-di did not inquire — drought followed three years.
units.idiomatic: Sima Rui's inaction brought triple drought.

units.zh: 流星起於牽牛，入紫微，龍形委蛇，其光照地，落於平陽北十里。
units.literal: A shooting star rose from Ox, entered Purple Palace, dragon-shaped writhing, light shining on earth, fell ten li north of Pingyang.
units.idiomatic: A draconic meteor fell north of Pingyang.

units.zh: 肉旁常有哭聲，晝夜不止。
units.literal: Beside the meat crying was often heard day and night without cease.
units.idiomatic: Wails rose from the meteoric flesh.

units.zh: 數日，聰后劉氏產一蛇一獸，各害人而走。
units.literal: Several days later Cong's empress Liu bore a snake and a beast; each killed people and fled.
units.idiomatic: Empress Liu whelped man-eating monsters.

units.zh: 尋之不得，頃之見於隕肉之旁。
units.literal: Seekers could not find them; soon they appeared beside the fallen meat.
units.idiomatic: The creatures haunted the flesh-mound.

units.zh: 是時，劉聰納劉殷三女，並為其后。
units.literal: Then Liu Cong took three daughters of Liu Yin as empresses together.
units.idiomatic: Liu Cong stacked three Liu brides.

units.zh: 天戒若曰，聰既自稱劉姓，三后又俱劉氏，逆骨肉之綱，成人倫之則。
units.literal: Heaven warns: Cong already claimed the Liu surname; three empresses also Liu — he violated flesh-and-bone ethics, broke human relations.
units.idiomatic: Incestuous Liu matches drew Heaven's rebuke.
